relations.rationale: If Nell is younger than Leo, it is consistent with Leo being the oldest participant.
Age comparison between Nell and Kira has no bearing on a group gathering to photograph creations.
Ivo being taller than Nell says nothing about his height relative to Noor.
Ivo's height relative to Nell has no connection to Noor's robot's paint color.
Ivo's height compared to Nell is unrelated to how well Kira's and Ivo's designs performed.
Ivo's height relative to Noor has nothing to do with the color of Noor's robot.
Ivo's height compared to Noor is unrelated to whether Noor's robot was easy to spot.
Ivo's height relative to Noor has no bearing on the performance of Kira's and Ivo's designs.
Leo being the oldest participant has no bearing on the number of parts in Kira's or Ivo's designs.
Leo's age status doesn't affect whether everyone gathered to compare notes and photograph creations.
Leo helping newer members solder wires has no connection to whether Noor's robot was easy to spot.
A bright yellow color would make Noor's robot stand out and thus easy to spot among others.
Using fewer parts doesn't preclude equal performance in trials, and could even support it as a design efficiency, but doesn't directly imply equal effectiveness.
